parsed_json.up: Select distinct molecule ChEMBL IDs and canonical SMILES for compounds tested against the neuropeptide S receptor (CHEMBL5162) in human assays. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then assays, then target_dictionary. Filter by target chembl_id CHEMBL5162 and assay organism Homo sapiens. Inner join compound_structures to require canonical SMILES. Alias the molecule identifier column as compound_chembl_id. Sort by compound_chembl_id.
